import React from "react"

let ug_state = 0
let ug_data = {}

function UgComponent(props) {

  function ugClick() {
    console.log("clicked")
    ug_state = ug_state + 1
    ug_data["last"] = ug_state
  }

  return (
    <div onClick={ugClick}>

      <h1>{"ugly jsx header"} {ug_state}</h1>

      <p>{props.value + ug_state}</p>

      {true && <span>{"always rendered ugly span"}</span>}

      {false ? <div>{"never rendered"}</div> : <div>{"always rendered"}</div>}

      <button onClick={function () {
        ugClick()
        eval("console.log('still unsafe but valid')")
      }}>
        click me
      </button>

    </div>
  )
}

export default function UgApp() {

  return (
    <div>

      <UgComponent value={1} />

      <UgComponent value={ug_state} />

      {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(function (i) {
        return <UgComponent key={i} value={i * i} />
      })}

      {(() => {
        if (ug_state > 3) {
          return (
            <div>
              <h2>{"state big"}</h2>
              <button onClick={function () {
                ug_state = 0
                ug_data = {}
              }}>
                reset
              </button>
            </div>
          )
        } else {
          return (
            <div>
              <h2>{"state ok"}</h2>
            </div>
          )
        }
      })()}

    </div>
  )
}

class UgWeirdClass extends React.Component {

  constructor(props) {
    super(props)
    this.state = { x: 1, y: 2 }
  }

  render() {
    return (
      <div onMouseMove={(e) => {
        this.setState({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY })
      }}>

        <h1>{this.state.x + this.state.y}</h1>

        <button onClick={function () {
          console.log("class click")
          eval("console.log('ugly class eval')")
        }}>
          ugly button
        </button>

        {this.props.children}

      </div>
    )
  }
}

globalThis.ug_jsx_leak = UgApp
